cd /workspace/tmp && python3 - <<'PY'
import json, random, sys, time
sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/tmp')
import cli, pyref
binary=cli.build()
rng=random.Random(31337)
d={}
while len(d)<8192:
    hi,lo=rng.getrandbits(64),rng.getrandbits(64); l=rng.randint(0,128)
    hi,lo=pyref.norm(hi,lo,l); d[(hi,lo,l)]=rng.randint(0,4194302)
    f16=len(set(k[0]>>48 for k in d if 17<=k[2]<=64)); f64=len(set(k[0] for k in d if k[2]>64))
    if f16>4096 or f64>4096: del d[(hi,lo,l)]
ops=[]
for r in range(3):
    ops += [['put','%016x%016x'%(k[0],k[1]),k[2],v] for k,v in d.items()]+[['save']]
req={'cases':[{'ops':ops},{'ops':ops}]}
t=time.time(); raw=json.dumps(req); print('request bytes',len(raw))
res=cli.run_request(req,binary); dt=time.time()-t
print('elapsed %.2fs response bytes %d'%(dt,len(json.dumps(res))))
for ci,r in enumerate(res['results']):
    print('case',ci,'saves',len(r['snapshots']),'loads',r['loads'],'rows',[sum(len(b) for b in s['banks']) for s in r['snapshots']])
